name: Forge-Heart
purpose: The heart of your keep — its hearth never goes cold.

name: Homes
purpose: Shelters families. Each level houses more townsfolk and raises manpower.

name: Barracks
purpose: Drills your companies. Each level speeds training by 5%.

name: Scriptorium
purpose: Houses scholars and preserves written knowledge. Each level speeds research by 5%.

name: Muster Yard
purpose: Gathers and provisions armies for the march. Each level speeds all marches by 4%.

name: Commanders' Hall
purpose: Recruit commanders. Each level widens the roster and grants another command slot.

name: Watchtower
purpose: Extends your scouts' sight. Higher levels return deeper intelligence.

name: Dragon Watch
purpose: A tower attuned to the sky, watched for signs of wings.

name: Roadworks
purpose: Keeps the realm's roads and bridges serviceable.

name: Smithy
purpose: Forges tools, nails, and the small ironwork a keep consumes daily.

name: Storehouse
purpose: Salts, cellars, and shields your stores from raiders. Each level protects more.

name: Walls
purpose: Stone and timber thrown against siege and storm.

name: Training Camp
purpose: Yards for mustering levies. Each level allows another training queue.
